properties.comment: This is a message from Volunteer Energy Cooperative. Please be advised that a planned power outage will occur in your area on Friday, November 20th, beginning at 8:30 AM Eastern Standard Time and lasting until approximately 30 minutes. This outage is necessary to allow crews to safely complete switching in the area. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience and understanding while these necessary upgrades are completed. Thank you.
